subject: ours:delegation
why: Owner ruling 17 (playbook map 2.17, 7.2): Orchestrate stays deferred and delegation grows by three rules from its Supervision section. A brief names what will show the work finished, and a unit with nothing to name is not dispatched. The coordinator opens the diff or artifact rather than relying on a summary. A stalled or looping worker is judged by what it produced and retried by cause, at most twice, then dropped and planned around. Our own words, with another model still from the roster or the owner and a reviewer's different-family rule kept. No upstream trait rows (README 4a's playbook exemption); the defer on Orchestrate stands. Added beyond the ruling: a cause you cannot tell retries on a narrower unit, so that state has an exit.
